summary: Identified 2 potential economic and systemic risks across the protocol surface.

risks.title: Oracle Price Manipulation
risks.description: Reliance on spot price or narrow-window TWAP from decentralized exchanges can be exploited via flash loans.
risks.impact: Attacker could manipulate collateral valuation to drain funds.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Use decentralized oracle aggregators (e.g. Chainlink) with circuit breakers.

risks.title: Liquidity Drain / Sandwiching
risks.description: High slippage tolerance or lack of deadline checks in swap functions allows for MEV exploitation.
risks.impact: Protocol and users lose value during state-changing swaps.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Implement strict slippage bounds and validate price impact before execution.
